parameters.name: Deleted
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to add or delete the log collection task. Valid values:

- -1: Deletes the task.

- 0: Adds the task.

parameters.name: DisPlayLine
parameters.description: The detailed information about the SLS log to be collected.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

parameters.name: SourceLogInfo
parameters.description: The detailed information about the Simple Log Service (SLS) log to be collected. The value is a JSON string.

parameters.name: SubUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account for which you want to collect logs.
